records.description: PluginEval quality methodology, covering dimensions, rubrics, and scoring formulas. Use this skill when understanding how plugin quality is measured, when interpreting a low score on a specific dimension, when deciding how to improve a skill's triggering accuracy or orchestration fitness, when setting score thresholds for your marketplace, or when explaining quality badges to external partners like Neon."
records.intro: PluginEval scores a skill or a plugin from 0 to 100 by combining up to three layers. The static layer is a lint. It's fast and deterministic, and it's useful for checking structure.
